# Decision — CASE-002

**Recommendation: Single source: Schrauben Werk Schwaben GmbH (road)** — landed EUR 38486.26 (EUR 0.2138/pc), full quantity on site 2026-08-31.

Consumption on ASSY-1 ran 18% above forecast for six weeks; on-hand is now below the reorder point with no open PO covering the quarter.

## Why this plan

- The line stops on 2026-09-11 at EUR 9200.00/hour. This plan keeps it running; EUR 0.00 of downtime avoided against the cheapest plan that does not.
- 180,000 pcs from Schrauben Werk Schwaben GmbH by road, ETA 2026-08-31. Landed EUR 38486.26; line keeps running.
